title: Project · The brief
description: What the client asked for, in their words, and two short lists side by side: what you found and what you did.

quote.default: “We wanted a kitchen we could all sit in, and light at the back of the house. And we really didn’t want to move out for six months.”

cite.default: Hannah Whitfield, at the first visit

default: A dark galley kitchen in a 1970s lean-to with a leaking roof
The rear wall shared with No. 14, so a party wall award was needed
Clay soil and a Victorian drain running under the garden
Took the lean-to down and built a 4.2 m steel-framed extension
Agreed the party wall award in week 3, before any digging
Re-routed the drain and piled the new footings
Kept a working kitchen at the front so the family never moved out
